questions.q: How does the book describe the limbic system?

questions.q: In the four communication scenarios, which one is described as ideal?
a: Both people operating in human mode
One person in human mode, the other in chimp mode
Both people behaving like monkeys
One person in chimp mode, the other in human mode

questions.q: What does the book say the chimp's sneakiest trick is?
a: Getting you to chase an illusionary perfect state of happiness
Making you avoid all challenges and responsibilities
Forcing you to compete with others constantly
Convincing you that you are never good enough
questions.why: The lesson on the chimp wanting more describes this as getting you to chase an illusionary perfect state.

questions.q: What happens when the human and chimp parts of the brain clash?
a: It leads to problems when the wrong one ends up in charge
The human always wins through logical reasoning
The chimp shuts down the prefrontal cortex entirely
Both parts merge into a single decision-making unit
questions.why: The two competing forces lesson states problems arise when the two clash or the wrong one ends up in charge.
